title: phlegmariurus delbrueckii
intro: Phlegmariurus delbrueckii, commonly known as the Delbrueck's climbing forklift, is a species of plant in the lycopodiaceae family. It is a type of club moss that has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its purported health benefits. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Phlegmariurus delbrueckii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
